automationNotes: Steps mirror the document exactly. App Switcher → Marketplace is automation-added navigation (docWarning logged). BigCommerce (Stack App) is used as the target app. UI Locations tab is visited before Configuration tab (opposite of doc order) because clicking Configuration tab causes BigCommerce to render content in iframes, making accordion elements inaccessible via CSS selectors. Webhook-related steps will fail if BigCommerce has no Webhook tab — reported as doc-app gaps.
